description: x402 endpoint checker: decodes an x402 endpoint's 402 payment terms without paying. GET url (optional method GET/POST, JSON body for POST). Sends one unpaid request; never pays or signs. Returns JSON: httpStatus, isX402, x402Version, decoded accepts (network, asset, USD amount, payTo, EOA or contract), discovery metadata presence, and pass/warn/fail checks. Any HTTP answer from the target, even 4xx/5xx, is billed; bad input, blocked hosts, connection failures and timeouts are not. Price $0.01 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).

body.description: Optional JSON body (string, <=8KB) for a POST probe; implies POST

method.description: Probe method: GET (default; retries POST on 405) or POST

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint to audit

name: x402_check
